text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking by the station, I spot an

advertisement for an event happening at
an
amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's this? "Feast of the Dead"?
Ooh, it
says it's a life-or-death game of
hide-and-seek
against zombies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! Are you into these
kinda
things too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, same! I wonder if Helios and the
others'd
be interested in checking this
out. Lemme just
send them a pic real
quick...
choice_data_list: 体を動かせそうだなと思って
choice_data_list_en: I figured you looked ready to move around a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Oh, I've got a LANE messa—huh?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios got sent to the infirmary?! Are
you
serious?!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she fainted in the library...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oof, that doesn't sound good. Thanks
for the
heads-up! I'll go see how she's
doing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
She might have a fever coming on... I
wonder if
she'll be able to keep down
some jelly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay, we've got cold medicine and
cooling
patches... Oh, we should get a
sports drink for her
too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, bestie, you're the GOAT!
Thanks a
bunch!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Glad to see you're all right.
You're
bursting at the seams with
energy, even! But you
sure you're good?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Never better! Doing all that homework

overheated my brain and high-key gave
me a
low-grade fever! Hilarious, no?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that LANE message you sent
me looked
like it got cut off halfway.
What's up with that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, don't worry about that. That's
on me for
typing and walking at the
same time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, never mind me. You need to
rest up
and—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You big liar!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Windy?! And Doto too... What are you
two doing
here?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-um, we happened to see you at the
station...
You looked like you were
panicking about
something, so we got a
little worried...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
We followed ya back to see what was
up, but
what gives, Palmer? Just be
honest and tell her ya
wanna go to that
event at the amusement park
together
already!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait, you saw me?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, is there something going on at the

amusement park?! I'm, like, sooo down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But, Helios... You're not feeling well.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on, who says I won't be better by
then?!
You've gotta be more open about
what you want,
bestie!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! A true minion of the
demon army
always gives in to their
greed!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm with everyone! Please let me know
if there's
anything I can do to help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You guys...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess if you all insist... But are
you sure? I
don't want to mess up your
plans. Or your health.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Heck yeah! We're with you to the end!
C'mon, say
it loud and proud, girl!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Okay! I want everyone here to go to
the event
at the amusement park with
me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And that includes you, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aghskdfl?! H-how did you know I was
here?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we all make plans to go to the

amusement park together, just as Mejiro
Palmer
requested.
